changes.before: Binding state-agency permitting restriction for data centers that consume or can consume 50 MW or more: DEC must hold incomplete discretionary permits, approvals, licenses, and similar permissions while DPS completes a statewide Generic Environmental Impact Statement; it does not override local permitting or zoning.
changes.after: Directs DEC to hold discretionary applications for construction or expansion of covered data centers that are or become pending before DEC and were not determined complete before 2026-07-14. Coverage follows the order's complete definition, including equipment/service characteristics and the 50-MW criterion and listed exclusions, including primarily manufacturing, research, education or medical-care facilities. Local-government permissions are excluded.

changes.bill_key: TX:Governor Abbott August 3, 2026 Data Center Audit Directive
changes.before: Directs PUCT and ERCOT to verify and audit every data center advancing through ERCOT interconnection before it may move forward, pausing the Batch Zero process pending the required review.
changes.after: Directs PUCT and ERCOT to conduct a comprehensive verification and audit of all data centers advancing through ERCOT interconnection before additional data centers are approved to move forward; noncompliant projects must be denied connection. Required information includes public financial assistance, power, water and cooling, community impacts, and ownership.
